mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a slow poison, an unnecessary waste of resources and it encourages false sense of satisfaction and importance."
Cigarette is a slow poison, an unnecessary waste of resources and it encourages false sense of satisfaction and importance.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the demographic majority in four emirates of UAE (Sharjah, Umm al-Quwain, Ras al- Khaimah and Ajman)."
Hanbali followers are the demographic majority in four emirates of UAE (Sharjah, Umm al-Quwain, Ras al- Khaimah and Ajman).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the strict traditionalist school of jurisprudence in Sunni Islam."
Hanbali school is the strict traditionalist school of jurisprudence in Sunni Islam.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to the Glorious Qur‟ān and the Prophetic Traditions as the basis of their analogical deduction (Qiyās) in order to arrive at a solution to a new matter."
The Muslims Jurists always refer to the Glorious Qur‟ān and the Prophetic Traditions as the basis of their analogical deduction (Qiyās) in order to arrive at a solution to a new matter.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a final resort to fix an unsuccessful family."
Divorce is a final resort to fix an unsuccessful family.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the smallest of four major Sunni schools, the others being the Hanafi, Maliki and Shafi`i."
The Hanbali madhhab is the smallest of four major Sunni schools, the others being the Hanafi, Maliki and Shafi`i.
fib: ______ is known as fiqh, while the science of ascertaining the precise terms from the sources is known as Usulul fiqh.
Muslim jurisprudence is known as fiqh, while the science of ascertaining the precise terms from the sources is known as Usulul fiqh.
______ is known about al-Shāfi‗ī's early life in Mecca, except that he was brought up in poor circumstances and that from his youth he was devoted to learning.
Little is known about al-Shāfi‗ī's early life in Mecca, except that he was brought up in poor circumstances and that from his youth he was devoted to learning.
______ is the expression of Allah's command for Muslims and, in application, constitutes a system of duties that are incumbent upon all Muslims by virtue of their religious belief.

The religious law of Islam is the expression of Allah's command for Muslims and, in application, constitutes a system of duties that are incumbent upon all Muslims by virtue of their religious belief.
______ may be defined as a process by means of which jurists derive sets guidelines, rules and regulations (the Shariah) from the principles of the Qur'an and the Sunnah.
Islamic jurisprudence may be defined as a process by means of which jurists derive sets guidelines, rules and regulations (the Shariah) from the principles of the Qur'an and the Sunnah.
______ is a fitting description of madhhab simply because law is the main area in which the schools have widely disagreed.
Legal school is a fitting description of madhhab simply because law is the main area in which the schools have widely disagreed.
